title: RaceEvent
description: A client event for the race engine. Mirrors extreme-race RaceEvent variant for variant and type for type; oneOf and property order follow the Rust variant and field order (the postcard bridge depends on it).

oneOf.description: Set the starboard end of the line at the current position.

Bump the start sequence. Not in a sequence: start one with the gun seconds from the tap. In a sequence: seconds > 0 moves the start earlier, < 0 later, and 0 syncs (rounds the time remaining down to a whole minute). timestamp is when the tap happened, in device time.

timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds on the device's clock (u64).

oneOf.description: Finish the race, or abort a start sequence.
